inputs.name: BaselineFile
inputs.purpose: MAT-file containing the baseline SimulationData Dataset.

inputs.name: CompareFile
inputs.purpose: MAT-file containing the comparison SimulationData Dataset.

inputs.name: BaselineRunID
inputs.purpose: Current Simulation Data Inspector run ID to use as the baseline.

inputs.name: CompareRunID
inputs.purpose: Current Simulation Data Inspector run ID to use as the comparison.

outputs.name: app
outputs.purpose: Structure containing the model, ViewModel, and view handles.

inputs.name: baselineFile
inputs.purpose: MAT-file containing the baseline SimulationData Dataset.

inputs.name: compareFile
inputs.purpose: MAT-file containing the comparison SimulationData Dataset.

inputs.name: Signals
inputs.purpose: Exact signal names to export; empty exports all comparable signals.

inputs.name: OutputFolder
inputs.purpose: Folder that receives one comparison plot per selected signal.

inputs.name: Format
inputs.purpose: Output format: png, jpg, tif, pdf, or svg.

inputs.name: BaselineDatasetName
inputs.purpose: Dataset variable to use when the baseline file contains multiple datasets.

inputs.name: CompareDatasetName
inputs.purpose: Dataset variable to use when the comparison file contains multiple datasets.

inputs.name: BaselineLegendText
inputs.purpose: Label appended to the baseline Dataset name in the legend; defaults to Baseline.

inputs.name: CompareLegendText
inputs.purpose: Label appended to the comparison Dataset name in the legend; defaults to Comparison.

inputs.name: TimeUnit
inputs.purpose: Displayed time unit: s, ms, or µs.

inputs.name: TimeShiftSeconds
inputs.purpose: Time shift applied to comparison signals, in seconds.

inputs.name: XLimits
inputs.purpose: Exported X-axis limits in the selected time unit.

inputs.name: Resolution
inputs.purpose: Resolution in DPI for raster exports.

outputs.name: exportedFiles
outputs.purpose: String array containing the generated plot file paths.
